description: Indoor form-sha from a floor-plan wireframe: 穿堂煞 (door-window alignment), 缺角 (nine-palace missing corners), 厕占中宫 (toilet at centre) — plus optional fusion with the Eight Mansions house stars and Ming Gua. Grade B verdicts, no aggregate score

birth_year.description: birth year for Ming Gua (enables personal palace stars + 宅命配)

plan.description: floor-plan wireframe: { exterior: [[x,y]...], rooms: [{kind, polygon}], openings: [{kind, a, b, is_entry}], walls: [[a,b]...] } in meters (y axis = north by drafting convention)

rotation_deg.description: plan y-axis deviation from true north, clockwise — must come from compass measurement

sitting_index.description: sitting mountain index 0–23 (0 = 子), enables Eight Mansions fusion

name: form_analysis
